body:
I need to clarify some issued being discussed in this thread.  First of all
the Unabomber (or the "Terrorist Group FC") has not been proved to be the
primary suspect Ted Kaczynski, so please quit referring to him as the Unabomber
when he is currently undergoing a legal appeal due to a gross violation of his
legal rights in the original trial.

That a bottle of Trazadone was allegedly found in his Montana cabin, no evidence
was ever presented that the medication was actually prescribed for Ted K.  Ted
was also extremely poor and would have been unable to afford to see a doctor or
pay for prescription medication, so most likely it was a bottle that he found
or obtained in some other way.  No evidence was ever presented by the government
that Ted Kaczynski was seeing a doctor for any mental disorder whatsoever, although
the government had no problem diagnosing him as a "paranoid schizophrenic" and
even the government-appointed psychiatrists assigned to "evaluate" him said that
his high IQ made accurate diagnosis difficult (in other words he passed all their
tests yet was still mentally ill because he was smarter than them).

Ted Kaczynski repeatedly tried to enter a "not-guilty" plea but was prevented
from doing so by his own government-appointed legal team who tried to enter an
insanity plea despite Ted's repeated, vehement protests and his attempts to
fire them and have them replaced or represent himself as was his constitutionally
guaranteed right (both were rejected by the judge in the case).

After all of this and repeated threats of a certain death-sentence, Ted K.
RELUCTANTLY agreed to a plea-bargain in which he would plead guilty in exchange
for a sentence of life in prison.  Afterwards, he decided that he was actually
coerced into entering the guilty plea and after doing much legal research on
his own filed a series of briefs with the court asking for an appeal.  Finally
one of the briefs was granted and Ted's case is currently being reheard in a
federal appellate court (I think Ted is representing himself).

I don't know if Ted is the Unabomber (FC) or not, and I don't care.  Whoever
"FC" is, he/they are a great writer!  Please take the time to read the Unabomber
Manifesto (titled "Industrial Society and its Future") before making judgements
on this person/group.  They are NOT the words of a madman.  I think the reason
the government hyped up the "schizophrenic" angle of the case is to discredit
the Manifesto as the rantings and ravings of a madman.  At one point I heard the
media describe it as "rambling and incoherent" which it is most certainly not!

Dark Cloud

"If our society had no social problems at all, the leftists would
 have to INVENT problems in order to provide themselves with an excuse
 for making a fuss."
-- Unabomber Manifesto (rambling? incoherent?)
